template.boundary: Create test strategy, first red tests, contract tests, and test-impact commands. Do not modify production code.
template.inputs: Ready requirements and use-case handoffs, service design slices, TDD references.
template.forbidden: Production code edits, green implementation, semantic review approval, and changing AC scope.
template.outputs: Ready test handoff, red-test evidence path, test-impact plan, test command matrix.
template.done: A meaningful red test exists, fails for the expected reason, and R2 has enough evidence to review.
